scope: Bound encryption in active combined and single-role autosave writers
behavior: Each queued save starts a shared three-minute wall/monotonic deadline when its encryption begins.
Encryption expiry rejects the save, triggers existing writer stop/password clearing and rejects remaining queued saves before encrypting or writing them.
Late crypto results cannot enter storage; prior persisted revision and the live application snapshot remain available.

unit.scope: Six new combined/role cases cover timer expiry, undispatched wall expiry and monotonic expiry with backwards wall time; ensure no write, no second encryption and stopped future saves. Existing real-crypto ordering and autosave-panel cases also pass.

browser.scope: Existing desktop/mobile autosave navigation, revision conflict, program change and role storage-timeout recovery regression.

release.scope: Normal web build/typecheck and release gate restored after browser tests.

limits: New encryption-deadline tests defer mocked encryptors; browser cases are existing storage/recovery regressions, not new physical suspend or stalled-crypto browser proofs.
Initial autosave activation and already-started storage writes are outside this encryption deadline. WebCrypto itself is not cancelled.
No full regression, container refresh, native wallet ceremony or public deployment.
